tests.title: Exact variable-canonicalization audit
tests.description: Requires variable-renaming invariance to be guaranteed by an exact declared method; heuristic relabeling must be marked noncanonical.

tests.title: Answer-leakage separation
tests.description: Rejects profiles, hashes, or features containing exact-alpha, SAT labels, or any answer-dependent diagnostic.

tests.title: DIMACS semantic-integrity audit
tests.description: Preserves empty clauses and validates headers, declared counts, literal ranges, and clause terminators.

tests.title: Monomial-basis transport audit
tests.description: Checks the exact change-of-basis matrix induced by coordinate permutations and complementations.

tests.title: Functional pullback degree audit
tests.description: Tracks certificate degree through acyclic bounded-fan-in functional extension definitions.

tests.title: Projection-fiber audit
tests.description: Separates functional definitions from nonfunctional existential fibers and hidden selectors.

tests.title: Exact rational Gram verification
tests.description: Requires supplied PSD claims to be replayable through exact rational factor identities.

tests.title: Pseudoexpectation gadget transport
tests.description: Tests whether local graph gadgets preserve bounded-degree pseudoexpectations with controlled overlap.

tests.title: Restriction-closed generator audit
tests.description: Requires an explicit hard-family generator to preserve its witness after every permitted large restriction.

tests.title: Reverse-lineage integrity
tests.description: Requires every new child to appear under each parent in an append-only reverse index.
